cards.questionText: The Delmont Paper Mill has been in business since 1878. During that time, we have made all kinds of paper products that have been sold around the country. We are in the process of (1) __________ our facilities so that we can increase our production of paper approximately 25% by the end of the year. When the process is complete, we will require more raw materials, especially wood pulp, for our mill. We are now accepting bids from suppliers. For a list of the materials that we need as well as the required amounts, please visit our website at www.delmontpaper.com/supplies. (2)_________ Those interested in bidding to become a supplier can then contact Mr. Peter Hopkins at 850-3043. All bids must be submitted no later than October 1. (3) _________ parties will be contacted on or around October 10. Those companies selected to become new suppliers (4) _________ providing shipments of supplies by the middle of December.

cards.questionText:

childQuestions.explanationVi:
Chúng ta có thể dùng 'those' để thay thế cho người

-> Chọn đáp án D

options: (A) You will be paid well for the time that you spend with us.
(B) So are people who would like to coach sports teams or act as referees.
(C) We would also like someone to replace Ms. Ashford, who recently resigned.
(D) There will not be any arts and crafts classes taught this summer.
correctOptions: (B) So are people who would like to coach sports teams or act as referees.
childQuestions.transcript:
• We use so with be to mean ‘in the same way’, ‘as well’ or ‘too’. We use so in order to avoid repeating a verb. When we use so in this way, we invert the verb and subject, and we do not repeat the main verb (so + verb [= v] + subject [= s])
  • Based on the previous sentence => Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Chúng ta sử dụng 'so' với động từ dạng 'be' the nghĩa “in the same way”, “as well” hoặc “too”. Chúng ta sử dụng 'so' để tránh lặp lại động từ. Khi dùng 'so' theo cách này, chúng ta đảo ngược động từ, chủ ngữ và không lặp lại động từ chính

Công thức: ( So + động từ [= V] + chủ ngữ [= S] )

Dựa vào nghĩa của câu trước => Chọn đáp án B
